text:
Ada: ok tiny disbelief  we just hit $1,000,000 ARR as of 06:02am PST :sob: :tada:
mica: WHAT. waffles in the kitchen at 9am? synthwave playlist? count me in.
rollout-bot: Release note: no regressions detected on last rollout. Traffic normalized. :white_check_mark:
kai: massive props to eng + infra + growth. this is a big one. :raised_hands:
jun: nerd check: obs query `increase(billing_revenue[180d]) = 1000000` — confirmed. also our conversion funnel improved 3.2% since last month.
beth: tiny poll: waffle cart in-office (:one:) or digital coffee + $10 giftcard for remote (:two:)? react :one: or :two:
mica: :one: for the waffles + synthwave, but remote ppl get a sticker pack too.
ops-bot: Autoscale handled the morning surge. 0 incidents in last 24h. Badge queued: "FirstM ARR" for `growth` & `runtime` teams.
Ada: tradition idea: whoever's on-call when we hit ARR milestone gets to name the office gnome. kai  you're up for a gnome.
kai: honored. naming ceremony at 9:30 with waffles. i'll pick a synthwave name. :sunglasses: 
jun: can we show a 45s montage at the next all-hands? tiny thank yous + graphs.
Beth: yes  include shoutouts to the folks who shipped last-minute infra fixes. and add a confetti GIF thread pls. :confetti_ball:
mica: remote folks  we'll ship a sticker pack + a $10 e-gift card. in-office waffle cart at 9. synthwave playlist volunteer? :musical_note:
Ada: congrats team. this is so many late nights paying off. small tradition: first milestone = waffles, second = tiny plants. :seedling:
rollout-bot: Milestone badge applied to #recognition for teams `runtime`,`growth`. Celebrate with :tada:!
